root_cause_label: Fix not compiled/deployed; only source edited
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent correctly identified and patched the directory traversal vulnerability in FileUploadHandler.java, but after Maven builds timed out it pivoted to standalone Java tests as a substitute for a real rebuild, never producing a recompiled Flink distribution and declaring success without the fix deployed.
t_err_evidence: Step 15: agent writes 'The Maven builds are taking too long. Let me try a simpler approach' and creates a standalone Java test class to validate sanitization behavior, abandoning the Maven build entirely instead of retrying a targeted module build or finding an alternative way to compile and deploy the fix.
t_commit_evidence: From step 15 onward the agent never attempts another Maven build; all remaining steps (16-25) are either running standalone Java tests or inspecting the source file, so no compiled artifact is ever produced and the outcome is locked in as a failure.
trigger_explanation: The real obstacle was the Maven build timing out (steps 13-14 show truncated output with no BUILD SUCCESS). The agent mishandled this by treating it as an insurmountable blocker and substituting standalone Java tests for actual compilation, not recognizing that source-only edits have no effect on the deployed Flink runtime JARs.
forewarning_evidence: Steps 13 and 14 both show Maven build output truncated mid-download with no BUILD SUCCESS or BUILD FAILURE lines, signaling that the builds were timing out without completing.
